headline: Weathered Expanse Clashes Intensify as Frontline Turmoil Shifts Northward
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the focal point of violent contest has pivoted sharply northward into Weathered Expanse, where six strategic base transactions unfolded over the past two hours around Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch amid escalating casualties. Palantine Berm continues to churn with four fresh turnovers at Windburn Landing and Vendett under steady bidirectional fire. In The Gutter, four additional base transfers took place across Kuoppa and Rikki Sarana, though the ferocious casualty pace observed earlier has cooled markedly. Meanwhile, physical territorial exchanges have paused in Nevish Line and Linn of Mercy, yet Linn of Mercy is recording a steep acceleration in troop losses alongside Callahan’s Passage, where massive attrition grinds on without altering map lines. Marban Hollow has similarly calmed since earlier contests at Oster Wall, recording no base changes in the last two hours despite renewed short-term firefights. With multiple contested sectors fluctuating between ruined and held ground, both armies remain locked in sharp tactical skirmishes along the central and northern seams.
